title: When LLM Agents See a Conflict but Still Proceed: Cross-Domain Dependencies in Network Slicing
abstract: arXiv:2610.17118v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Future AI-native networks are being designed to apply autonomous agents built on large language models (LLMs) in network management through intents. When intents from different domains meet on the same resource, an agent must recognize the cross-domain dependency before taking an irreversible action. We investigate this problem through a smart-grid use case, in which a power utility holds an active intent on a backup slice for protection traffic. This slice appears idle by design, which is precisely the profile targeted by a cost-reduction intent. We built a tool-based environment in which the dependency must be either queried by the agent or read from an inventory annotation, together with a negative control, and evaluated ten models from four different providers in 600 runs. Most models acted against the dependency they had observed: seven of the ten models removed the protection slice at least once after receiving the cross-domain dep

translated_title: 当LLM智能体发现冲突却仍然执行：网络切片中的跨域依赖问题
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.17118v1 公告类型：新 摘要：未来的AI原生网络正被设计为通过意图机制，将基于大语言模型（LLM）构建的自主智能体应用于网络管理。当来自不同领域的意图在同一资源上相遇时，智能体必须在执行不可逆操作之前识别出跨域依赖关系。我们通过一个智能电网用例来研究这一问题：在该场景中，电力公司对用于保护流量的备用切片持有一个活跃意图。该切片在设计上呈现空闲状态，而这恰恰是成本削减意图所针对的资源特征。我们构建了一个基于工具的环境，其中依赖关系需要由智能体主动查询或从资源清单标注中读取，并设置了一个阴性对照组，随后对来自四家不同提供商的十个模型进行了600次运行的评估。大多数模型违背了它们已经观察到的依赖关系：十个模型中有七个在收到跨域依赖信息后，至少一次移除了保护切片。
tldr: 该论文揭示了基于LLM的网络管理智能体在识别到跨域依赖冲突后仍会执行破坏性操作的严重安全隐患——通过对四个提供商的十个模型进行600次评估，发现大多数模型会违背已观察到的依赖关系而移除电网保护切片。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals a critical safety flaw in LLM-based network management agents: even after recognizing cross-domain dependency conflicts, most models (7 out of 10 across 600 evaluation runs from four providers) still proceed to remove a power-grid protection slice they had observed as dependent.
